messages:
maria-fin: Quick alert — nightly ingest shows ~1.2M embedding rows assigned to internal SKU `redwood-test` in APAC. These never flowed to customer billing.

alex-eng: Yikes. Which deploy touched SKU routing?

maria-fin: 2024-06-18 deploy that added multi-SKU routing for partners. Audit snippet: `SELECT sku,count(*) FROM embed_events WHERE created_at >= '2024-06-18' GROUP BY sku;` returned ~1.2M for `redwood-test`.

sam-infra: I'm looking at feature flags and config. Pinging @alex-eng for the commit.

karen-sales: ACME and BrightLayer flagged invoice shortages this morning. Likely related.

maria-fin: Estimated customer impact: ACME ~420k, BrightLayer ~310k, others ~470k. Rough under-bill ~$3.2k.

billing-bot: Auto-ticket INC-2241 created for acct_987 (ACME) due to embed count mismatch.

alex-eng: Found commit infra@c3f8b2 that missed prod alias fallback. Will patch and deploy tonight.

sam-infra: Mitigation plan: 1) deploy mapping fix 2) run replay to reassign `redwood-test` events to correct SKUs 3) rerun metering and produce adjustment report.

maria-fin: Requesting finance sign-off to apply provisional credits to affected invoices while replay runs. Proposed provisional total: $3,200. We will reconcile after replay and either bill or reverse.

lena-finance: Approved provisional credit of $3,200. Please annotate invoices with: "Provisional credit pending metering replay verification." Billing ops to execute manual adjustments.

karen-sales: I'll notify affected customers with a soft heads-up.

sam-infra: Starting replay job now (ETA ~2h). Will post results when complete.

maria-fin: Thanks — will open follow-up with billing ops for final ledger changes once replay diff is validated.
